title: LAST STOP · Part 1
gemini_style: scared teenage boy telling it fast, close to the mic, tense and real

vo_open.text: The last train stopped at a station with my name on the sign.
vo_open.cap: The last train stopped at a station with *my name* on the sign.
vo_open.de: Die letzte Bahn hielt an einer Station mit meinem Namen auf dem Schild.
vo_open.es: El último tren paró en una estación con mi nombre en el letrero.
vo_open.fr: Le dernier métro s’est arrêté à une station qui portait mon nom.
vo_open.tts: The last train stopped at a station with MY name on the sign.

vo.text: Every passenger turned to look at me. None of them blinked.
vo.cap: Every passenger turned to look at me. *None* of them *blinked.*
vo.de: Alle Fahrgäste drehten sich zu mir um. Keiner blinzelte.
vo.es: Todos los pasajeros se giraron a mirarme. Ninguno parpadeaba.
vo.fr: Tous les passagers se sont tournés vers moi. Aucun ne clignait des yeux.
vo.tts: Every passenger turned to look at me. <short pause> None of them blinked.

vo.text: The conductor handed me a ticket. One way. Tonight.
vo.cap: The conductor handed me a ticket. *One way.* *Tonight.*
vo.de: Der Schaffner gab mir ein Ticket. Nur Hinfahrt. Heute Nacht.
vo.es: El revisor me dio un billete. Solo ida. Esta noche.
vo.fr: Le contrôleur m’a tendu un ticket. Aller simple. Ce soir.
vo.tts: The conductor handed me a ticket. <short pause> One way. <short pause> Tonight.

vo.text: An old woman whispered: don't get off. Whoever gets off here becomes the station.
vo.cap: An old woman whispered: *don't* get off. Whoever gets off here *becomes the station.*
vo.de: Eine alte Frau flüsterte: Steig nicht aus. Wer hier aussteigt, wird zur Station.
vo.es: Una anciana susurró: no te bajes. Quien baja aquí se convierte en la estación.
vo.fr: Une vieille dame a chuchoté : ne descends pas. Celui qui descend ici devient la station.
vo.tts: An old woman whispered... don't get off. Whoever gets off here... becomes the station.

vo.text: Then the doors opened. And my mom was on the platform, waving at me.
vo.cap: Then the doors *opened.* And my *mom* was on the platform, *waving* at me.
vo.de: Dann gingen die Türen auf. Und meine Mutter stand auf dem Bahnsteig und winkte mir.
vo.es: Entonces se abrieron las puertas. Y mi madre estaba en el andén, saludándome.
vo.fr: Puis les portes se sont ouvertes. Et ma mère était sur le quai, à me faire signe.
vo.tts: Then the doors opened. <short pause> And my mom was on the platform... waving at me.
